name: kanban
description: Connects rush to kanban-code: Claude reads the board and its own card, starts agents on cards, hears when a card's PR fails a check or gets a review, and shows the board in rush's agent list.
prompt: The user tracks work on a kanban-code board. If your task is a card on it, mcp__rush-kanban__my_card shows the card: its issue, its PR, failing checks and unresolved review threads. mcp__rush-kanban__board shows the whole board, and start_card starts another agent on a card.
